blocks.text: Ladner Lots & Vacant Land — Frequently Asked Questions

parts.t: Where do residential building lots come from in Ladner?

Because Ladner is surrounded by the Fraser River and ALR farmland, most urban building sites come from subdividing wider 1960s–1970s residential lots into two compact lots or purchasing an older house at lot value in
What geotechnical and Flood Construction Level rules apply when building in Ladner?

All Ladner residential lots sit within the Fraser River floodplain. Before issuing a building permit, the City of Delta requires a geotechnical engineer's report specifying site preload duration or foundation design and confirming that habitable floor elevations meet the area's Flood Construction Level (FCL).
How does BC Bill 44 (SSMUH) affect single-family lots in Ladner?

Provincial Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing rules require municipalities to allow 3 to 4 housing units on qualifying urban single-family lots inside the Urban Containment Boundary, subject to City of Delta zoning standards, flood-level compliance, parking, and sewer/water capacity.
Does 5% GST apply when purchasing a vacant lot in Ladner?

GST (5%) commonly applies to newly subdivided vacant residential lots sold by a developer or builder. Always verify GST registration status and include explicit GST language in the Contract of Purchase and Sale.
What are Development Cost Charges (DCCs) in the City of Delta?

When subdividing a lot or building new units in Delta, municipal and Metro Vancouver Development Cost Charges apply to fund water, sanitary sewer, drainage, roads, and parks infrastructure, alongside utility connection and engineering inspection fees.
How does Delta's Tree Protection Bylaw affect lot clearing?

The City of Delta Tree Protection Bylaw requires a permit to remove protected trees above threshold trunk diameters, an arborist assessment during demolition/building permit review, and replacement tree planting or municipal cash-in-lieu contributions.
How do urban Ladner building lots compare with Ladner ALR farmland?
